name: Captain's Documents
summary: The Captain's Documents are papers recovered from beneath Theramore's docks. Nazeer Bloodpike values them for what they may reveal about Theramore and the Alliance.

sections.title: Beneath the Docks
sections.body: Brackenwall Village spies sought papers aboard a ship at Theramore Isle. When they were discovered, one cast the documents into a footlocker and threw it beneath the docks. Nazeer Bloodpike now sends you to recover the papers, which he believes may bear on the Horde's security.

faq.answer: They are papers taken from a ship at Theramore Isle by Brackenwall Village spies. They were thrown into the waters beneath the docks when the spies were discovered.

faq.q: Why does Nazeer want the documents?
faq.answer: Nazeer Bloodpike believes the papers hold information about Theramore's ties to the Alliance, and that this knowledge matters to the Horde's security.
The documents were sealed in a footlocker beneath the docks of Theramore Isle.

faq.q: Who sent the spies to Theramore?
faq.answer: The spies came from Brackenwall Village. Nazeer Bloodpike directs the effort to recover the papers.
The papers are written in Common, and Nazeer keeps their contents to himself. Their precise account of Theramore's ties to the Alliance remains unknown.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you are sent to recover papers that Nazeer believes may reveal Theramore's standing with the Alliance and help protect Horde interests.
